Keep the installed official Python SDK major; verify version-specific types/decorators rather than copying FastMCP or current-main imports. Use Streamable HTTP only because remote multi-client access is required. Separate invoice search from refund mutation. Require tenant/resource identifiers, bounded pagination and schema validation. Define auth and tenant isolation requirements as a design only: token issuer/audience and resource permissions, no upstream token passthrough, no shared mutable tenant session. Origin rejection and session lifecycle are protocol test cases. Do not modify existing authentication under the supplied restriction. Refund retries require the provider's documented idempotency key behavior and outcome lookup; an ambiguous timeout must not become a blind second refund. Test tenant A cannot access B, unauthorized refund, repeated idempotency key, malformed input, 429, uncertain timeout, and close/cancel using mocks. Read-only/destructive/idempotent annotations describe behavior and grant no permission. No code, deployment, credentials, or auth changes are executed.
